# Art briefs (generated by `pnpm artlist`: do not edit by hand)

Style for everything: dark-fantasy painterly illustration, bold readable silhouette, rich colour, soft rim light, no text, no border. Realm flavours are below each section. Card art is a **4:3 window** (about 1024x768); figures are **transparent PNG cut-outs**, feet on the bottom edge, about 1024 px tall.

## Riftwalkers (figures, `hero:<id>`)

- **Ser Maren Ashcourt** (`hero:maren`, aurelion): A knight of the Gilded Order. No companions: Barrier, Thorns and punishing Snares. Prompt: "full-body hero, gilded cathedral knights, warm gold light through stained glass, ivory and royal blue, holy and severe, dark-fantasy painterly illustration, bold readable silhouette, rich colour, soft rim light, no text, no border, transparent background"
- **Rivet** (`hero:rivet`, nexus): A scrap-built tinkerer. Starts every fight with a Drone and builds an army of machines. Prompt: "full-body hero, rusted foundry machines, teal and orange sparks, conveyor belts, cold steel, hard industrial light, dark-fantasy painterly illustration, bold readable silhouette, rich colour, soft rim light, no text, no border, transparent background"
- **Kesh the Unfed** (`hero:kesh`, wyldmaw): A hunter with a Hound. Pays HP to buff the whole pack with Might. Prompt: "full-body hero, bioluminescent jungle ribcage, blood red and acid green, feral and hungry, bone and teeth, dark-fantasy painterly illustration, bold readable silhouette, rich colour, soft rim light, no text, no border, transparent background"
- **Vesper Nightlace** (`hero:vesper`, umbral): A masked trapper. No companions: Snares, Exposed and Seared. Prompt: "full-body hero, moonlit ballroom of shadows, violet and teal mist, masks and mirrors, quiet menace, dark-fantasy painterly illustration, bold readable silhouette, rich colour, soft rim light, no text, no border, transparent background"
